summary: Joseph Tawil discusses the custom of not eating walnuts on Rosh Hashanah as mentioned by the Muram in his glosses to the Shulchan Aruch. He explains the reasons provided by the Maharil regarding mucus and the Gematria of the word egoz, and clarifies that these are not laws or customs for the Sephardic community. He also references the Chida and the Midrash to show that there is no issue with eating nuts on the holiday.
